disclaimer: FICTIONAL SOFTWARE DEMONSTRATION. No real drug, study, patients or clinical safety evidence. Scores are unvalidated reviewer-attention heuristics, NOT predicted adverse-event risk or clinical enrollment decisions.

study.title: SYN-217 Phase 3 Oncology Eligibility Review
study.fictional_drug_class: Oral targeted small-molecule inhibitor with fictional CYP3A-dependent metabolism
study.indication: Advanced non-small-cell lung cancer after prior systemic therapy
study.primary_goal: Identify renal-impairment exclusion potentially eligible for review using fictitious drug-specific pharmacokinetic evidence
study.study_scope: Every synthetic record is an adult assumed to meet cancer indication, prior-treatment and consent conditions; only the modeled criteria below are assessed.

source_registry.title: Enhancing Participation in Clinical Trials — Eligibility Criteria, Enrollment Practices, and Trial Designs
source_registry.use: High-level rationale to review unjustified exclusions; not direct proof of SYN-217 safety.

source_registry.title: Cancer Clinical Trial Eligibility Criteria: Patients with Organ Dysfunction or Prior or Concurrent Malignancies
source_registry.use: Organ-dysfunction eligibility should reflect drug- and patient-specific considerations.

source_registry.title: Cancer Clinical Trial Eligibility Criteria: Laboratory Values
source_registry.use: Laboratory restrictions need a justified safety rationale and may be reconsidered as evidence accumulates.

source_registry.title: Cancer Clinical Trial Eligibility Criteria: Performance Status
source_registry.use: Review the rationale for performance-status restrictions; this demo conservatively keeps the ECOG limit unchanged.

source_registry.title: Cancer Clinical Trial Eligibility Criteria: Washout Periods and Concomitant Medications
source_registry.use: Medication restrictions should relate to relevant drug interaction evidence.

fictional_drug_evidence.label: SYN-217 mass-balance pilot
fictional_drug_evidence.summary: Fictional model: about 7% of a dose recovered unchanged in urine; CYP3A pathway is important.
fictional_drug_evidence.limitations: A route-of-elimination observation alone cannot establish safety in renal impairment.

fictional_drug_evidence.label: SYN-217 renal impairment PK sub-study
fictional_drug_evidence.population: Stable adult participants with eGFR 45–59 mL/min/1.73 m²
fictional_drug_evidence.summary: Fictional modeled exposure ratio (AUC) 1.12 compared with the reference group, and no clear early exposure-related safety pattern in this small sample.
fictional_drug_evidence.limitations: Small invented dataset; no data for eGFR <45; no conclusion that any proposed patient is safe.
fictional_drug_evidence.supports: Only a clinician-reviewed discussion of revising the synthetic renal eligibility boundary to >=45, not a treatment or enrollment recommendation.

fictional_drug_evidence.label: SYN-217 strong CYP3A inhibitor interaction study
fictional_drug_evidence.summary: Fictional model: coadministration with a strong CYP3A inhibitor was associated with a 2.7-fold higher exposure.
fictional_drug_evidence.supports: Retain the modeled strong CYP3A inhibitor exclusion pending drug-specific clinical review.

fictional_drug_evidence.label: SYN-217 performance-status evidence inventory
fictional_drug_evidence.summary: Fictional model: limited observations in ECOG 2 patients, insufficient to establish appropriate SYN-217 eligibility rules for this group.
fictional_drug_evidence.supports: Flag ECOG 2 for additional evidence review; retain the original ECOG 0–1 limit for the current scenario.

fictional_drug_evidence.label: SYN-217 hepatic evaluation inventory
fictional_drug_evidence.summary: Fictional model: evidence is inadequate to propose eligibility for moderate or severe hepatic impairment.
fictional_drug_evidence.supports: Retain the current modeled hepatic exclusions; missing hepatic status causes indeterminate classification unless another criterion excludes.

fictional_drug_evidence.label: SYN-217 cardiac safety evaluation inventory
fictional_drug_evidence.summary: Fictional model: no adequate evidence to support including clinically unstable cardiac disease.
fictional_drug_evidence.supports: Retain modeled exclusion for clinically unstable cardiac disease.

clinical_criteria.proposed: eGFR >=45 mL/min/1.73 m² (candidate revision for expert review)
clinical_criteria.justification: Synthetic supporting exposure data cover only a stable eGFR 45–59 subgroup; nothing supports extension below 45.
Fictional ECOG2 sample is too small to justify changing this scenario; FDA guidance recommends evaluating narrower exclusions in real protocols.
Fictional DDI evidence identifies exposure increase with flagged medication.

clinical_criteria.original: Normal or mild hepatic impairment only
clinical_criteria.justification: No fictional drug evidence for moderate/severe hepatic impairment.
No fictional drug evidence to justify including unstable cardiac disease.

rule_sets.renal_metric_note: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m²) is a lab eligibility proxy in this fictional protocol, not an individualized dosing calculation.

review_attention_index.name: Illustrative review-attention index
review_attention_index.applies_only_to: Newly matching synthetic records under clinician-reviewed scenario; never used to override exclusion or missing info.
review_attention_index.formula: renal = 12+(60-eGFR) if 45<=eGFR<60 else 0; ECOG1 +5; mild hepatic +8; controlled hypertension +3; stable type2 diabetes +5; stable cardiac history +10; cap at 100. Age is not scored.
review_attention_index.ranking: Ascending index among newly matching records only; score is a fictional UI review-priority demonstration.
